quest.title: A Strange Story in Konda
quest.description: A mysterious, masked shrine maiden is by the strange fox statue, seemingly with something to request of you...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x350, Primogem x40, Mora x20000

dialogues.text: Excuse me, busy Traveler, but I have a favor to ask.
Please, look at the Sky Kitsune Statue over there.
There is a ward within it that they say can only be removed by someone who has courage, values friendship, and who is favored by the might of <color=#00E1FFFF>Electro</color>.
I was right. You are the "Destined One."
With your skills and experience... Mm, this shouldn't be a problem.

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: Excuse my rudeness. My name is Hanachirusato, and I am a shrine maiden.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do shrine maidens usually wear masks?

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: ...I have my reasons for that.

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: The village in front of you is named Konda Village, and there is a... barrier within it that needs to be lifted.

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: That barrier is hidden behind a certain secret. I'd like to entrust you with a little investigation, and with lifting that barrier.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Yes. It may take some time and trouble, but I'm sure that you will reveal the truth in the end.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, that sounds like a lot of work. Will there be payment?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Hehe... Of course.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: "To those who seek shall just reward be given in proportion to their wisdom and work."

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: ...That's what she used to say. So no, there is no need to worry.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I shall be counting on you for this investigation, Destined One.

choices.text: I see. I'll get a move on, then.
Will there be a reward for that?

talks.objective: Use the power of Electro on the Sky Kitsune Statue

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: I wrote down all the events at that time and the location of the key before throwing the notes onto the roof. You can read it yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: After entrusting the secret to a kind young person like you, I'm more relieved now...

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: *sigh* Did Konda Village become like this because I couldn't fulfill my duty to the gods?
There is a ward within it that they say can only be removed by someone who has courage, values friendship, and who is favored by the might of <color=#00E1FFFF>Electro</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This should be Konda Village.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Secrets... Hmm, yes, Paimon smells something suspicious!

choices.text: Paimon's nose is better than a dog's...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How rude! Paimon was just saying the obvious.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe. It might look very peaceful here, but Paimon's sure that there's gotta be something dark going on.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Really?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There's gotta be some secrets here! Miss Masked Maiden said so.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, let's talk to the locals first. Maybe we can find something out...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehehe, the secret that the people of Konda Village are trying to hide!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right!

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: What can I do for you, youngster?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You are...?

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: My name is Konda Densuke, and I am the village chief.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: From the way you dress, you must be an outsi— I mean, outlander, right? It's been a long time since an outlander has come to the village.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: How can I help you? Need a place to rest your feet? Or do you need help to find your way up the mountain?

choices.text: I'm looking for a place to rest.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No! We're here to ask about the secret of Konda Village!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...Oh boy.

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: Secret? Konda Village doesn't have any secrets.

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: Although the economy isn't good these days, all the taxes that should be paid to the police station are paid regularly, regardless.

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: There are only a few families in our village, all with a long history. And we know each other's roots. How could we have any secrets?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Calm down a little...

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: Konda Village is simple and peaceful. There are no secrets here.

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: If you're looking for secrets, why don't you just go to the Grand Narukami Shrine and learn the secrets of deciphering fortune slips? Or how about you go to Chinju Forest and see if you can hear the "tanuki-bayashi," huh!?

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: Phew... Sorry, I might have overreacted.

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: Konda Village is a peaceful place. Youngster, are you sure you don't have the wrong village?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But...

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: If you don't believe me, <color=#00E1FFFF>you can look around yourself</color>. I, Konda Densuke, will not stand in your way.

choices.text: I want to go up the mountain.

talks.objective: Ask the Konda Village Chief for information

dialogues.speaker: Takeru
dialogues.text: Amazing, you climbed up so easily!

dialogues.speaker: Takeru
dialogues.text: #Hmmm...? Looking at you, {M#mister}{F#lady}, you should be an outlander, right?

dialogues.speaker: Takeru
dialogues.text: It's been a super long time since I've seen an outlander!

dialogues.speaker: Takeru
dialogues.text: Well then, speak: What can Konda Takeru do for you, O outlander from afar?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What an arrogant little kid...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you noticed anything strange lately?

dialogues.speaker: Takeru
dialogues.text: *shh* Keep your voice down... I can tell you, but promise me you won't get scared!

dialogues.speaker: Takeru
dialogues.text: During thunderstorms...

dialogues.speaker: Takeru
dialogues.text: ...things get spooky around here!

dialogues.speaker: Takeru
dialogues.text: There's a strange spooky ghost lady!

response.speaker: Takeru
response.text: Huh, how can you be so calm after I told you something like that?

response.speaker: Takeru
response.text: When I told Grandpa Densuke, he didn't believe me either. He said that I must have been mistaken...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Any other unusual things going on?

response.speaker: Takeru
response.text: I guess that would be the <color=#00E1FFFF>broken cart</color> at the entrance of the village. I wonder who left it there?

response.speaker: Takeru
response.text: See, that's it over there. There are hilichurls digging at it, too!

choices.text: I'll say hi to her when I see her...

dialogues.speaker: Futaba
dialogues.text: #Hello, strange {F#big sis}{M#big bro}! What's up?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you encountered anything strange lately?

dialogues.speaker: Futaba
dialogues.text: Strange? Uh... I don't get it. What kinds of things would you consider strange?

response.speaker: Futaba
response.text: Hmm... Hmm...

response.speaker: Futaba
response.text: I know!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Did something come to mind?

response.speaker: Futaba
response.text: There's a weirdly dressed outlander and a floating white... thing talking to me!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That is indeed strange.

response.speaker: Futaba
response.text: I know, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! You two!

response.speaker: Futaba
response.text: Okay, I'll be serious. One night, it suddenly started raining very heavily. Then, I heard a strange sound outside the house that accompanied the sound of the rain.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Strange sound?

response.speaker: Futaba
response.text: Yes, it was like an intermittent clicking, clacking sound!

response.speaker: Futaba
response.text: The next day, I went to check it out! Then I saw some <color=#00E1FFFF>floating bags</color> in the village gully.

response.speaker: Futaba
response.text: I left them alone because I didn't know who had put them there...

response.speaker: Futaba
response.text: They might have washed away by now. You can take a look along the gully!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Were there any other clues?

response.speaker: Futaba
response.text: Other than that... I can't think of any.

response.speaker: Futaba
response.text: You can go ask my dad! He knows a lot of things.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Your dad?

response.speaker: Futaba
response.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>Konda Densuke</color>, the chief of Konda Village.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? That old man is your dad?

response.speaker: Futaba
response.text: Actually, I was adopted. He adopted me, so now I'm his daughter.

response.speaker: Futaba
response.text: Oh! You can also go ask my nephew, Takeru.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait a second. Nephew...?

choices.text: I see. He is the village chief's grandson.

response.speaker: Futaba
response.text: That's right. <color=#00E1FFFF>Takeru likes high places</color>, so maybe he's seen something from there...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This family's pretty complicated...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I see. Thank you.

response.speaker: Futaba
response.text: Hehe. Glad that I could help!

response.speaker: Futaba
response.text: *sigh* Why isn't Takeru here yet? We were supposed to hang out today.

response.speaker: Futaba
response.text: Did he go up to the roof again...?

response.speaker: Futaba
response.text: My dad's grandson. I'm my father's daughter, so he's my nephew.

choices.text: Like something that is hard to explain.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This must be the broken cart Takeru mentioned!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But other than some tattered paper, Paimon doesn't see anything special here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's see... The contents of this piece of paper are... a Shogunate ledger of goods and payments...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The goods are... "this book" blah blah blah... "participating in" blah blah... and the number is something-something volumes?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It says "volumes," which must refer to things made of paper, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's tightly locked, just like Granny said...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm? There seems to be something here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow! It's a marked coin pouch!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, are you thinking what Paimon's thinking?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's on your mind?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's thinking about buying lots and lots of snacks with this Mora!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm thinking that there shouldn't be a coin pouch here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah! You mean that we should make it disappear, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Just kidding. Hmm, a coin pouch by the well... That means...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Someone is hiding something.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...And this well's in the village chief's yard.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... This must be one of the "floating bags" that Futaba mentioned!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hee-hee, let's see what's inside...

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: Hello, youngster. Are you here to listen to this old woman's stories?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you encountered anything strange lately?

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: The strangest thing is how we haven't heard from Jirou for such a long time...

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: My old husband's even put up a search notice in Inazuma City.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: *sigh* Jirou used to hang out with the young gangsters in the village.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: We urged him to join the army because they were together from morning to night and were always up to no good.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: Maybe the kid's broken off contact because we pushed him too hard...

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, it seems like I haven't seen any of those punks for a while, either.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything else out of the ordinary?

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: Out of the ordinary... Let's see...

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: In the past, traders and tourists from various countries would disembark at Ritou, and they would pass through our village on their way to Inazuma City.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: The village was always busy and we would open our doors for outlanders. But that hasn't happened for a long time. That's unusual, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: Mr. Imatani never worried much about the kids in the past, nor would Jirou ever have fought any war no matter who told him to. This is also very abnormal.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: And the deserted shrine at the foot of the mountain would never have fallen into disrepair in the past like it has now. I've heard that the statue of the Great Fox occasionally sheds tears. That's not normal either, is it?

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: The Konda family's well is always dry, even though there is plenty of water all around. Someone locked the well up the other night, and not a soul knows who did it. This kind of thing isn't normal either, right?

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: Little Takeru even said that he saw a ghostly woman during a stormy night. But who or what would haunt such a peaceful village? This too is very abnormal, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: Hehehe... There are just too many strange goings-on for an old woman like me. Are these what you wanted to know?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, about the punks you mentioned earlier...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you know where they are, Granny?

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: They're a band of troublemaking brats. They most likely went somewhere new to make trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: As long as Jirou isn't influenced by them, I couldn't care less.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: Still, you just reminded me of something...

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: I've heard that for a while, there was a lot of Mora scattered inside <color=#00E1FFFF>the dry well behind the village chief's house</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: But a group of ronin came to the village later and took almost all of it.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: That's all I know. If you want to know more, you can go ask our village chief.

talks.objective: Cut a deal with the Village Chief

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: This is... This is...

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: I can't believe that I was so careless when I was damaging the cart...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey now, you finally admitted it!

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: Since you have already gotten this far in your investigation, there's nothing for it. I can't hide it anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: In that case, you should have a pretty good idea of what happened.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A very good idea indeed! Grandpa Densuke, you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Tried to rob a Shogunate cart, didn't you? And in the midst of the struggle, you destroyed the cart with a single punch, causing the goods to go flying into the gully.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hoping to save themselves, the Shogunate's people threw their coin pouches into the well to distract you! And then, you locked the well up to prevent others from stealing the Mora!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is that right?

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: Ah? No, that's not what happened at all!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? Paimon was gonna ask for your key and to have that Mora at the bottom of the well...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Surrendered to the Shogunate! That's right! They were definitely going to be surrendered to the Shogunate!

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: *sigh* Well, this is what actually happened...

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: There was originally a group of young people in the village who got too bold after getting drunk, and actually robbed one of the Shogunate's cargo carts. These goods and the bag both belong to the Shogunate.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: I couldn't let others know that this shameful incident occurred in our village. That's why I tried to cover it up.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What about your confession regarding the coin pouch...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He did that to cover up the truth.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: That's right. I thought that you would stop the investigation once I confessed.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: If it was just me... As long as no one else was affected...

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: Please don't report this to the Shogunate. This isn't about me saving face. I just don't want the entire village to be dragged down in the process.

choices.text: I'm not interested in reporting you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, that's not why we came here!

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: Oh, thank goodness! Thank goodness...

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: My conscience kept bothering me because of this cover-up, so I recorded everything in a diary.

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: I threw the diary onto the roof. If you really want to read it, help yourself, but please don't ruin my recently renovated roof.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: About the lock on the well...

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: Yes, it was me who locked the well up. I also wrote down where I hid the key. Go read for yourself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Grandpa Densuke, do you know anything about the Konda Village barrier?

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: Barrier? Oh, so people still know about that old legend...

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: They say that in ancient times, underneath the ground we are standing on right now, lay the roots of the Thunder Sakura. Indeed, this was one of the five roots that protect the peace on Narukami Island.

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: And guarding it and its barrier was said to be a responsibility assigned to us, the Konda Clan, by the Kitsune Saiguu herself.

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: But this was a long, long time ago. I hardly recall anything about the details.

choices.text: I just want to know the truth...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, we didn't come here to report you!

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: The truth? Hehe... You young people these days are so interesting.

talks.objective: Look for the Chief's diary on the rooftop

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke's Notes
dialogues.text: (Most of the notes are illegible due to their exposure to the elements.)

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke's Notes
dialogues.text: "...But the lies and cover-up of this thievery weigh heavily on me. Therefore, I decide to leave these notes..."

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke's Notes
dialogues.text: "...The group attacked the public drunkenly, stealing no small amount of goods and some pouches of Mora..."

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke's Notes
dialogues.text: "...After much discussion, it was decided that this matter should be covered up... The cart was destroyed in the night. The goods and coin pouches were dumped down an empty well..."

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke's Notes
dialogues.text: "...The well was sealed and locked, and the key was hidden in <color=#00E1FFFF>a broken house across the gully on the east side of the village</color>... Legend has it that it was built by Douin. Sadly, it's now so desolate that it proved a fitting choice to hide such a key..."

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke's Notes
dialogues.text: "...Konda Village should've been prosperous. The Konda Clan should've thrived... I hope... for the sake of Takeru and Futaba... this village shall remain free of mishaps..."

talks.objective: Head over to the designated area recorded in the notebook
Descend into the well in Konda Village
Explore the bottom of the well

dialogues.speaker: Futaba
dialogues.text: #Are you looking for those bags, {F#big sis}{M#big bro}? <color=#00E1FFFF>If you follow the gully</color>, you might find them!

dialogues.speaker: Well Lock
dialogues.text: (The dry well is locked and looks like it could be opened with the corresponding key...)

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: Very impressive.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eek! How did you... When did you... Why...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yikes!

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: I was right to have my eye on you. You are indeed qualified to perform the Cleansing.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I was quite concerned as to your actions, and as to whether you could heal the roots or not, so I have been observing you a little. If I have offended you, please forgive me.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: You have helped me greatly already by being able to undo the barrier.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If she's been watching us all this time, that means...

choices.text: Are you reporting us to the authorities?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: The authorities? Who do you mean?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You know, the people in charge of the whole Konda Village thing.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Are you referring to the matter that the people of Konda Village have hidden away?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I am loyal to Narukami Island, not some police station.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Besides, she... I have had dealings with Konda Village for a long time as well. If those families were to be cut off, I would not be able to face...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Please excuse me. Let us get back to business.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: As you may know, the Thunder Sakura trees symbolize the eternal watch of the Electro Archon, and they have the power to remove evil and purify the earth.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: However, the polluted tree roots will eventually be corroded, and these tainted sections will form tumors, one after another.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: That is why we must perform the Cleansing Ritual.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Unfortunately, my... physical condition, shall we say, prevents me from accomplishing this deed.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: There are several more barriers of this kind. Can I ask you to aid me... No, to aid this land?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Do not fret... Our priority is the cleansing.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I see. I'll help.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Thank you, truly.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: As for the location of the next barrier, you can visit the abandoned shrine nearby. It's not far northeast of Konda Village.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Due to certain circumstances, I fear that I cannot go with you.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How will we meet up, then?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: "The sakura on the east and west banks differ in speed, and the flowers of the north and south branches vary their bloom."

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: However, everything on this island is under her... Under the Sacred Sakura's shade. So long as petals still fall like snow upon this island, we will surely meet again.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I wish you all the best.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: As you can see, I am simply a shrine maiden who wishes to cleanse evil with your aid.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you, youngster.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: Thank you so much for helping us with Jirou.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How is he doing?

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: He's doing well, thanks to you. But considering his situation, it's best that he doesn't come out to greet you for now.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: Anyway, I'm glad that he came back alive. He told me what he went through... and it's a blessing that he met you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you encountered anything strange lately?

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: If I must say so, Jirou being as peaceable as his is now is most strange.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: This is thanks to you, too.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: *sigh* He used to hang out with the young gangsters in the village.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: We urged him to join the army because they were together from morning to night and were always up to no good.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: I thought that he would learn how to deal with people in the army, or at least understand how to be sincere with people, and stop giving others troubles.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: He failed to learn any of that in the army, but his experience with you sure showed him a thing or two. Hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: If he gets restless again... I'll teach him a lesson.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, so scary!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything else out of the ordinary?

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: Out of the ordinary... Let's see...

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: In the past, traders and tourists from various countries would disembark at Ritou, and they would pass through our village on their way to Inazuma City.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: The village was always busy and we would open our doors for outlanders. But that hasn't happened for a long time. That's unusual, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: Mr. Imatani never worried much about the kids in the past, nor would Jirou ever have fought any war no matter who told him to. This is also very abnormal.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: And the deserted shrine at the foot of the mountain would never have fallen into disrepair in the past like it has now. I've heard that the statue of the Great Fox occasionally sheds tears. That's not normal either, is it?

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: The Konda family's well is always dry, even though there is plenty of water all around. Someone locked the well up the other night, and not a soul knows who did it. This kind of thing isn't normal either, right?

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: Little Takeru even said that he saw a ghostly woman during a stormy night. But who or what would haunt such a peaceful village? This too is very abnormal, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: Hehehe... There are just too many strange goings-on for an old woman like me. Are these what you wanted to know?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, about the punks you mentioned earlier...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you know where they are, Granny?

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: They're a band of troublemaking brats. They most likely went somewhere new to make trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: As long as Jirou is no longer influenced by them, I couldn't care less.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: Still, you just reminded me of something...

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: I heard that several bags of Mora were found in the dry well behind the village chief's house.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: But a group of ronin came to the village later and took almost all of it.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: That's all I know. If you want to know more, you can go ask our village chief.

dialogues.speaker: Takeru
dialogues.text: How can I convince Grandpa Densuke that there really is a ghost...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell him something weird...

dialogues.speaker: Takeru
dialogues.text: Besides the ghost? That would be <color=#00E1FFFF>the broken cart at the entrance of the village</color>!
You were able to retrieve the ward... That means that you really are the "Destined One."
With your skills and experience... Mm, this shouldn't be a problem.

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: Excuse my rudeness. My name is Hanachirusato, and I am a shrine maiden.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do shrine maidens usually wear masks?

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: ...I have my reasons for that.

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: The village in front of you is named Konda Village, and there is a... barrier within it that needs to be lifted.

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: That barrier is hidden behind a certain secret. I'd like to entrust you with a little investigation, and with lifting that barrier.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Yes. It may take some time and trouble, but I'm sure that you will reveal the truth in the end.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, that sounds like a lot of work. Will there be payment?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Hehe... Of course.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: "To those who seek shall just reward be given in proportion to their wisdom and work."

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: ...That's what she used to say. So no, there is no need to worry.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I shall be counting on you for this investigation, Destined One.

choices.text: I see. I'll get a move on, then.
Will there be a reward for that?

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: Greetings.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Konda Village has a long history. In the distant past, its people were once charged with the duty of guarding a certain barrier.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: But too many things have been lost to time, and this barrier has now become something that must be removed.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I wish you all the best.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: There is a barrier under Konda Village. For the sake of Narukami Island, we must lift it.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: However, the path to the barrier is shrouded in Konda Village's secrets.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I believe that you will see through the mystery of the villagers' words and reach the place appointed by destiny, just as you did with the ward...

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: Ah, look at this old lady, only focusing on talking about her own son...

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: Well, if you're interested in what's going on, go over to <color=#00E1FFFF>the dried-up well</color> and check it out.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: I've told you, there's nothing wrong here.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: If you don't believe me, just check it out for yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: *sigh* You again...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The villagers have told us everything...

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: They did? What did they say?

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: Don't you think you can fool an old man like me with these baseless accusations...
